opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs) and exempt/excepted charities with at least one year of annual accounts. Must pass eligibility quiz.
opportunities.summary: Funding for operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activity projects. Applications accepted year‑round with no deadline.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK charities with annual income over £1 million, or projects/capital costs over £1 million. Must pass eligibility quiz and submit an Expression of Interest. Eligible for operating/core, capital, or project grants.
opportunities.summary: Large‑scale funding for operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activity projects. Applications accepted year‑round with no deadline; considered at eight board meetings per year.
